handback.title: All tests run on the owner's commits
handback.summary: Pins that the owner's pushes to a Dokima pull request run all tests, like agent pushes.
handback.user_story: The owner's pushes to a Dokima pull request get the same all tests check as agent work.

acceptance_criteria.text: A push by the owner to a Dokima pull request runs all tests, with no rule skipping the owner.
acceptance_criteria.words: My work goes through the same reviews and checks as agent work.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One push, one pusher; the bot's same push is checked beside it as the good case.

test_changes.tests/test_checks.py::test_full_suite_ru: Already true, so this older check pins it, playing the owner's real login.

answers.why: The check now plays the owner's login from the code owners file as the repository's owner.
